{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
if trial_df['patient_id'].duplicated().any():
    print('Duplicate patient_id found. Keeping highest sample_seq per patient_id.')
    # Keep the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient_id
    trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')
else:
    print('No duplicate patient_id found.')

# Check sex distribution
sex_dist = trial_df['sex'].value_counts()

# Check arm distribution
arm_dist = trial_df['arm'].value_counts()

# Check severity distribution
severity_dist = trial_df['severity'].value_counts()

# Check if arms are balanced across sex and severity
arm_sex_cross = pd.crosstab(trial_df['arm'], trial_df['sex'])
arm_severity_cross = pd.crosstab(trial_df['arm'], trial_df['severity'])

# Check response rate by sex
response_by_sex = trial_df.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()

print('--- Sex Distribution ---')
print(sex_dist)
print('\n--- Arm Distribution ---')
print(arm_dist)
print('\n--- Severity Distribution ---')
print(severity_dist)
print('\n--- Arm vs Sex Cross-tab ---')
print(arm_sex_cross)
print('\n--- Arm vs Severity Cross-tab ---')
print(arm_severity_cross)
print('\n--- Response Rate by Sex ---')
print(response_by_sex)"}
